name: Drugged Stupor
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components S, M (some kind of poisonous fungi or drug)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one helpless creature
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You place the helpless creature in a clouded, confused state. The target cannot think clearly, take actions and is unaware of their surroundings. The target can be moved or forced to walk along, if guided by another creature.
